title: Kill -9 of the app AND every background process of its bundle (daemon, holder, terminal hosts), reopen: each terminal's last screen and its whole scrollback come back exactly, a 'session ended' line follows them, and the new shell starts in the same path string (/tmp stays /tmp)
why: REOPEN-F3 (STATUS 4421, P0 data loss, cmux-ad 01:30Z): on the dogfood build f350103 a kill of every cmux process lost the last screen (400 numbered lines) and the 363-row scrollback; the terminal showed only '- session restored (previous process ended) -' and a new prompt in /private/tmp. A Mac that crashes, a force quit of everything, or a kernel panic leaves exactly this state.
source: REOPEN-F3 (STATUS 4421, 4426), owner of the fix reopen-f3

steps.title: set-up: Home finishes its first load
set-up: 400 numbered lines, the last on screen; the scrollback holds the rest
set-up: the app saves what it saves at its own pace (no quit runs: a kill gives no chance)
SIGKILL of every process of the bundle (hosts and holder first, then daemon and app), reopen
the last screen and the whole scrollback are back, exactly (1..400 once each, in order), with a 'session ended' line after them
the new shell starts in the same path string the terminal had (/tmp, not /private/tmp)
